# 🔨 MaceSMP — The Ultimate Custom Mace Weapon System

Transform your SMP's combat experience with **MaceSMP**, a high-powered Paper/Spigot plugin tailored for Minecraft 1.21.1+. Instead of standard vanilla weapons, MaceSMP introduces three unique, high-tier weapon paths featuring custom execution matrices, celestial mechanics, and leveling progression.

---

## 🌟 Core Loop & Progression System
Every weapon starts at **Level 1** with baseline modifiers. 

*   **Upgrade by Domination:** Defeating another player updates your weapon's internal data container, permanently ranking it up (+1 Level and custom density modifiers) and splashing a server-wide visual achievement!
*   **The Hard-Core Risk:** If you die, your weapon **loses 1 Level** and drops a physically floating **Mace Level Container** on the ground. Anyone can steal your lost level container and right-click it to upgrade their own weapon!
*   **Crafting Alternative:** Don't want to hunt players? Assemble a **Mace Level Container** using rare vanilla assets (Gold Blocks, Diamonds, and an Eye of Ender) to advance your weapon potential safely.

---

## ☄️ Weapon Archetypes & Mechanics

### 🪽 The Angel Mace (Celestial & Utility)
*   **Level 1 — Astral Projection:** Right-click to depart your physical frame! Enter a **10-second Spectator Mode** to scout enemy lines. If your physical body is attacked, you immediately snap back. If it takes a fatal blow, trigger an automatic *Angel Resurrection* to restore your life and take flight!
*   **Level 2 — Beyond Potential:** Unleash creative-style flight for **10 seconds**, leaving a vortex of wind trails behind you. Upon expiration, explode violently to blow back your pursuers—with *built-in fall damage protection*!
*   **Level 3 — Angel Shower:** Command an orbital bombardment, striking all nearby entities with cascading lightning matrices.
*   **Bonus Action — Angel Beam:** Right-clicking while flying or resurrected shoots a 30-block energy beam, dealing precision instant damage.

### 💨 The Breeze Mace (Kinetic & Agility)
*   **Level 1 — Wind Burst:** Right-click to launch yourself forward/upward into the sky using raw kinetic velocity. Full fall-damage immunity included!
*   **Level 2 — Thunderous Smash:** Landing a smash attack from a fall distance strikes your target with real lightning, multiplying damage scales based on how high you fell.
*   **Level 3 — Cloud Jump:** Drop a massive shockwave circle beneath you, leaping extraordinarily high. When you finally hit the deck, a heavy kinetic explosion clears out the battlefield.

### 🩸 The Damage Mace (Raw Power & Berserker)
*   **Level 1 — Heavy Criticals:** Passively scales an extra +15 flat physical damage onto your base hits, spawning heavy particle trails.
*   **Level 2 — Adrenaline Rush:** Right-click to inject yourself with a 20-second burst of **Strength II** and **Speed II** to turn the tide of an asymmetric fight.
*   **Level 3 — Absolute Strength:** Arm an absolute blow. Your next successful attack bypasses standard calculations to instantly strike for **250.0 damage**, vaporizing your opponent in a flash of thunder.

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Configuration
Admin commands require operator status or the `macesmp.admin` permission node.

*   `/givemace breeze` — Spawns the baseline Level 1 Breeze Mace structure.
*   `/givemace damage` — Spawns the baseline Level 1 Damage Mace structure.
*   `/givemace angel` — Spawns the baseline Level 1 Angel Mace structure.

### 🚀 Join Gift
To get the action started instantly, the plugin detects when a player logs into your SMP for the very first time and **automatically gifts them one random custom Mace archetype** to kick off their journey!

---

### 📦 Installation
1. Ensure your server runs **Paper** or **Purpur** (1.21.1 or higher).
2. Drag and drop the `MaceSMP.jar` into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Completely restart your server console.
4. Log in, become OP, and type `/givemace` to start testing!
